MasterDetail changes do not add a second cursor or invisible owner registration.
Scoped bubble routing retains the initial event focus/top guard before any fallback and revalidates every scoped candidate. Bounded frame diagnostics and drop-count append remain intact.

MasterDetail measure delegates to shared composition and SplitPane measurement. Draw reports actual layout and renders real groups without running input handlers or domain effects. The public catalogue example uses data-owned documents and one shared block configuration.
